// Detect edit mode from URL param (mirrors PHP ?actionEdit=) const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search); const editId = params.get('actionEdit'); if (editId) { // Switch to edit mode — mirrors PHP editForm() document.getElementById('formTitle').textContent = 'Edit Student'; document.getElementById('cardTitle').textContent = 'Edit Student Information'; document.getElementById('txtOldIDNo').value = editId; document.getElementById('txtIDNo').value = editId; document.getElementById('btnSave').style.display = 'none'; document.getElementById('btnUpdate').style.display = ''; // In a real PHP setup the server fills the fields; here we show the ID. // You'd fetch from your API or rely on server-side rendering. } // Live preview — shows card as fields are filled const previewCard = document.getElementById('previewCard'); const fields = ['txtIDNo', 'txtLName', 'txtFName', 'txtMName', 'txtAddress', 'cmbCourse', 'cmbYear']; function updatePreview() { const id = document.getElementById('txtIDNo').value.trim(); const ln = document.getElementById('txtLName').value.trim(); const fn = document.getElementById('txtFName').value.trim(); const mn = document.getElementById('txtMName').value.trim(); const addr = document.getElementById('txtAddress').value.trim(); const course = document.getElementById('cmbCourse').value; const year = document.getElementById('cmbYear').value; if (id || ln || fn) { previewCard.style.display = ''; document.getElementById('prev-idno').textContent = id || '—'; document.getElementById('prev-name').textContent = [ln, fn, mn].filter(Boolean).join(', ') || '—'; document.getElementById('prev-addr').textContent = addr || '—'; document.getElementById('prev-course').textContent = course || '—'; document.getElementById('prev-year').textContent = year || '—'; } else { previewCard.style.display = 'none'; } } fields.forEach((id) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.addEventListener('input', updatePreview); if (el) el.addEventListener('change', updatePreview); });
